idb.note: Plain HTTPS gets a genuine Cloudflare 'Sorry, you have been blocked' page (HTTP 403, server: cloudflare) on every iadb.org path - host refusal, not a permission denial. The rendered fetch route serves. The country-offices index lists 26 countries but prints no city or address for any of them, so each office was read from its own page at /en/who-we-are/country-offices/<country>. Those per-page fetches fail intermittently on first try and succeed on retry (rate limiting, not 404). Headquarters came from /country-offices/idb-headquarters; the Tokyo and Madrid offices are not under /country-offices at all but at /en/how-we-can-work-together/strategic-partnerships/office-asia and /idb-office-europe. /en/who-we-are/country-offices/contact-us never served in this session (client_error on every attempt).

idbinvest.note: Fully open over plain HTTPS (HTTP 200). The contact page names only one office: 'IDB Invest headquarters / Washington / IDB Invest Building'. It prints the city but no street address. https://www.idbinvest.org/en/countries (HTTP 200) lists no offices at all. This single record is filed under lender key 'idbinvest', NOT 'idb', because IDB Invest is a separate arm - the owner should decide whether to fold it into the idb key. Note the existing dataset's IDB Invest status was 'could not be opened'; it can be opened, but there is only this one office to get.

afdb.note: Plain HTTPS is fully blocked: afdb.org returns a Cloudflare managed JS challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...', cf-mitigated: challenge) on EVERY path including /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml - host refusal, not a permission denial. The rendered fetch route serves. NO single office-directory page was found: the site's nav carries a 'Country Office Contacts' link but the fetch tool strips hrefs, /en/contacts, /en/countries, /en/countries/country-office-contacts, /en/contacts/country-office-contacts, /en/about-us/contacts/country-office-contacts and /en/about-us/structure/field-offices all failed on repeated tries, and 14 WebSearch calls surfaced no afdb.org directory URL (only third-party aggregators such as developmentaid.org, which were not used because they are not the lender's own page). The addresses here were instead taken from AfDB's own per-country pages, whose pattern /en/countries/<region>/<country> was surfaced by search via the Burundi page. Each such page prints that country's office address plus its region's address. The five region pages were also read for the regional offices. Not readable on repeated tries (3+ attempts each, consistently, while sibling pages on the same host succeeded in the same batches - so these are probably wrong slugs rather than rate limiting): /en/countries/east-africa, /en/countries/southern-africa, /en/countries/east-africa/uganda, /en/countries/southern-africa/madagascar, /en/countries/central-africa/democratic-republic-congo, /en/countries/west-africa/cabo-verde. Uganda, Madagascar and DR Congo therefore have no record here even though AfDB may well have offices there. Not attempted at all: comoros, seychelles, mauritius, guinea-bissau, libya, equatorial-guinea.

bii.note: Still blocked on both routes, as expected. Plain HTTPS: HTTP 403 with 'cf-mitigated: challenge' and 'server: cloudflare' on /en/contact/, / and /en/about/offices/ - a Cloudflare bot challenge, i.e. genuine host refusal, not a permission denial. Rendered fetch: client_error, nothing retrieved. Tested once each as instructed; no further effort spent. Zero records.

ifc.note: Serves over plain HTTPS (HTTP 200). CONFIRMS the existing single record is right rather than incomplete: the directory page's own HTML prints exactly one address, 'IFC Headquarters, 2121 Pennsylvania Avenue, NW, Washington D.C. 20433, United States', and then a 'Loading...' placeholder. The office list is fetched at runtime from https://webapi.worldbank.org/aemsite/ifc/search/people, an OData service that needs a subscription key embedded in the page. Reading that key out of the page to query the service was DENIED BY THIS SESSION'S PERMISSION SYSTEM (Website Access Circumvention) - that is a permission denial, NOT the host refusing - and it was not worked around. The public regional pages were read instead and carry no office addresses whatsoever: /en/where-we-work/africa, /europe, /south-asia and /western-europe all return HTTP 200 but print no city, street or office name (their 'Contacts' content is also loaded from the same gated service), and /east-asia-and-pacific, /latin-america-caribbean and /middle-east-central-asia return HTTP 404. No new IFC records; none added here, to avoid duplicating the existing headquarters record.

notes.merges: Three merges under the existing rule that one office described under two titles at the same address becomes one record: AfDB Abidjan ('Cote d'Ivoire Headquarters' and 'Department West Africa Region', same 24eme Etage Immeuble CCIA address) kept as headquarters; AfDB Nairobi ('East Africa Regional Hub (RDGE)' and 'East Africa Regional Resource Center (EARC)', same Khushee Tower address); AfDB Centurion ('Southern Africa Regional Development and Business Delivery Office' and 'Southern Africa Resource Center (SARC)', same 339 Witch-Hazel Avenue address).
notes.kind_calls: IDB Tokyo ('Office in Asia') and Madrid ('IDB Office in Europe') are marked 'regional office' under the existing rule for a liaison or representative office in a donor capital. AfDB Yaounde holds two records - the Central Africa Region regional office and the Cameroon Country Office - at different addresses, which the lender+city+kind uniqueness rule allows.
